summary: iter156 backend validation — Verified per-agent identity injection via build_identity_fragment + compose_system_prompt stacking across all 6 chat entry points. All targeted tests + full regression pass (230/230).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 5120 lines — well beyond the 700-line guideline; ongoing decomposition already tracked in iter121-124. Continue extracting the /chat/message pipeline (approx L2400-L2700) which now mixes fallback-chain assembly with system-prompt composition.

compose_system_prompt swallows all DB exceptions silently in load_profile (except: pass). While this is intentional (avoid breaking chat on Mongo hiccup), it also hides misconfigurations. Consider logger.warning inside the except so ops can detect ai_profiles collection issues.

server.py L2538: `_agent_id = model_choice.replace('-', '_').replace('.', '_')` — no validation that _agent_id exists in AGENT_REGISTRY. If model_choice is arbitrary (e.g. 'foo-bar'), build_identity_fragment returns '' (safe) but the log line still prints 'AI identity+profile applied for agent=foo_bar', which could mislead debugging. Minor: log the resolved fragment length or 'no_registry_match' when card is None.
seed_data_creation: None — all runtime tests use in-memory mock DB.
context_for_next_testing_agent: iter156 introduces AGENT_REGISTRY-driven identity injection. Key invariants now under test: (1) build_identity_fragment(agent_id) returns non-empty distinct fragments per known agent and '' for unknown/empty ids; (2) compose_system_prompt stacks base → identity → Créa profile in that exact order; (3) all 6 entry points (server.py, caly_routes.py, community_bots_routes.py, chat_agent.py, dev_agent.py, planner_agent.py) call compose_system_prompt; (4) cross-agent isolation: dev fragment contains 'Forge' but not 'Archi', planner contains 'Archi' but not 'Forge'; (5) dev_agent emits 8 progression event kinds (status/status_done/search_done/file_viewed/file_created/file_modified/code_executed/validation); (6) registry.py planner prompt explicitly contains 'pas de raisonnement privé'. Full regression across iter141-156: 230/230 passed in ~2s. Runtime log line 'AI identity+profile applied for agent=<id>' emitted at server.py:2540 inside send_chat_message try-block.
